contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: feature text (heading, icon or numbered list, price, CTAs) beside a product/people image

usage: Product/feature split section with an icon list or numbered steps beside an image.
reuseGuidance: steps/steps-2/steps-3 number the list in the text cell (steps-2 wider spacing, steps-3 with dividers); light flows an icon list in two columns; accordion turns headings in the text cell into expandable panels.
